name: Transmutation Hall
spec: **national wonder** — one per civilisation; 300; maintenance 2; ⟨Provides [6] [Prima Materia]⟩; Scientist ×1 — no production at all: the Hall makes matter, not goods, and its two Gold of upkeep are the alchemists who are not at the forge. One Hall, not one per city: transmutation is a capital industry, not an empire-wide income — the physics calls it ruinous by hand, and the mine-head Vats, the Athanors and Dispersal are how it scales. (Verified in `TurnManager.kt`: each turn a civilisation gains its resource *supply* of every stockpiled resource, and `Provides` counts toward supply — so a building yields a stockpile directly, with no yield to convert. A negative production stat would also work — the engine sums building stats without a floor — but upkeep says the same thing more legibly, and specialists cannot yield stockpiles natively, so an Alchemist slot would need a further extension.) The loss the physics demands sits in the *re-locking*.
